"use client";

import { useEffect, useRef, useState } from "react";
import Link from "next/link";
import { ArrowDown, ArrowLeft, ArrowRight, ArrowUpRight } from "lucide-react";
import gsap from "gsap";

type HeroSlide = {
  category: string;
  title: string;
  description: string;
  image: string;
  position?: string;
};

const slides: HeroSlide[] = [
  {
    category: "Child Safety",
    title: "Life Saving Skill",
    description:
      "Empowering children with CPR and life-saving skills to respond confidently in emergencies.",
    image: "/images/hero/life-saving.jpg",
  },
  {
    category: "Drowning Prevention",
    title: "SwimSafe Training",
    description:
      "Practical survival swimming skills helping children become safer in and around water.",
    image: "/images/hero/swimsafe.jpg",
  },
  {
    category: "Water Safety",
    title: "SeaSafe Lifeguard",
    description:
      "Strengthening lifeguard skills and promoting safer beaches and coastal communities.",
    image: "/images/hero/seasafe.jpg",
  },
  {
    category: "SwimSafe Programme",
    title: "SwimSafe Graduation",
    description:
      "Celebrating the achievements of children completing their survival swimming training.",
    image: "/images/hero/swimsafe-graduation.jpg",
  },
  {
    category: "Life-Saving Skills",
    title: "Safer Communities",
    description:
      "Building practical water safety skills for children and communities across Bangladesh.",
    image: "/images/hero/safer-communities.jpg",
  },
  {
    category: "Child Development",
    title: "Anchal",
    description:
      "Creating safe and supportive environments for children and families in communities.",
    image: "/images/hero/anchal.jpg",
  },
  {
    category: "Eye Health Research",
    title: "Nationwide Blindness Survey",
    description:
      "Generating evidence to understand blindness and strengthen vision care across Bangladesh.",
    image: "/images/hero/blindness-survey.jpg",
  },
  {
    category: "World Drowning Day 2026",
    title: "Together for Safer Waters",
    description:
      "Raising awareness and strengthening drowning prevention for safer communities across Bangladesh.",
    image: "/images/hero/safer-waters.jpg",
  },
];

const SLIDE_DURATION = 7500;

export default function Hero() {
  const [activeIndex, setActiveIndex] = useState(0);
  const [paused, setPaused] = useState(false);
  const [ready, setReady] = useState(false);

  const sectionRef = useRef<HTMLElement>(null);
  const contentRef = useRef<HTMLDivElement>(null);
  const initialized = useRef(false);

  const activeSlide = slides[activeIndex];

  const goTo = (index: number) => {
    setActiveIndex((index + slides.length) % slides.length);
  };

  useEffect(() => {
    if (paused) return;

    const timer = window.setInterval(() => {
      setActiveIndex((current) => (current + 1) % slides.length);
    }, SLIDE_DURATION);

    return () => window.clearInterval(timer);
  }, [activeIndex, paused]);

  useEffect(() => {
    const media = window.matchMedia("(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)");

    if (media.matches) {
      setReady(true);
      return;
    }

    const scope = contentRef.current;
    if (!scope) return;

    const elements = scope.querySelectorAll("[data-hero-reveal]");

    gsap.killTweensOf(elements);

    const animation = gsap.fromTo(
      elements,
      {
        opacity: 0,
        y: initialized.current ? 22 : 36,
      },
      {
        opacity: 1,
        y: 0,
        duration: initialized.current ? 0.65 : 1,
        stagger: 0.09,
        ease: "power3.out",
        clearProps: "all",
      }
    );

    initialized.current = true;
    setReady(true);

    return () => {
      animation.kill();
      gsap.killTweensOf(elements);
    };
  }, [activeIndex]);

  return (
    <section
      ref={sectionRef}
      id="home"
      aria-label="Featured CIPRB programmes"
      className="relative isolate min-h-[760px] overflow-hidden bg-[#F5F7FA] pt-[150px] text-[#102945] sm:pt-[170px] lg:min-h-[850px] lg:pt-[185px]"
      onMouseEnter={() => setPaused(true)}
      onMouseLeave={() => setPaused(false)}
      onFocusCapture={() => setPaused(true)}
      onBlurCapture={(event) => {
        if (!event.currentTarget.contains(event.relatedTarget)) {
          setPaused(false);
        }
      }}
    >
      {/* Background editorial decoration */}
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute top-0 right-0 h-[420px] w-[55%] rounded-bl-[180px] bg-[#E9F0F8]/55"
      />
      <div
        aria-hidden="true"
        className="pointer-events-none absolute -bottom-36 -left-36 h-96 w-96 rounded-full bg-[#DFEAF7]/45 blur-3xl"
      />

      <div className="relative mx-auto w-full max-w-[1700px] px-5 sm:px-8 lg:px-12 2xl:px-20">
        {/* Top editorial index */}
        <div className="mb-9 flex items-center justify-between gap-6 border-b border-[#D6E0EB] pb-5 lg:mb-12">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-3">
            <span className="h-2 w-2 rounded-full bg-[#0C4DA2]" />
            <span className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[0.2em] text-[#0C4DA2] uppercase sm:text-[11px]">
              Centre for Injury Prevention and Research, Bangladesh
            </span>
          </div>

          <span className="hidden text-[11px] font-medium tracking-[0.16em] text-[#718198] uppercase md:block">
            Research • Prevention • Impact
          </span>
        </div>

        <div className="grid items-center gap-12 lg:grid-cols-[0.89fr_1.11fr] lg:gap-12 xl:gap-20">
          {/* Left: typography and content */}
          <div
            ref={contentRef}
            aria-live="polite"
            aria-atomic="true"
            className={`relative z-10 flex flex-col items-start pb-2 transition-opacity duration-300 ${
              ready ? "opacity-100" : "opacity-0"
            }`}
          >
            <div
              data-hero-reveal
              className="mb-7 flex items-center gap-3"
            >
              <span className="h-px w-9 bg-[#0C4DA2]" />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.21em] text-[#0C4DA2] uppercase">
                {activeSlide.category}
              </span>
            </div>

            <h1
              data-hero-reveal
              className="max-w-[760px] text-[clamp(3.8rem,6.6vw,8.1rem)] leading-[0.99] font-bold tracking-[-0.075em] text-[#102945]"
            >
              {activeSlide.title}
              <span className="text-[#0C4DA2]">.</span>
            </h1>

            <p
              data-hero-reveal
              className="mt-8 max-w-[510px] text-[16px] leading-[1.85] font-normal text-[#64748B] sm:text-[18px] xl:text-[19px]"
            >
              {activeSlide.description}
            </p>

            <div
              data-hero-reveal
              className="mt-9 flex flex-wrap items-center gap-5 sm:mt-11"
            >
              <Link
                href="#about"
                className="group inline-flex min-h-[60px] items-center gap-7 rounded-full bg-[#0C4DA2] py-2 pr-2 pl-7 text-[13px] font-semibold text-white shadow-[0_12px_30px_-15px_rgba(12,77,162,0.5)] transition-all duration-300 hover:-translate-y-1 hover:bg-[#083E84] hover:shadow-[0_18px_35px_-12px_rgba(12,77,162,0.45)] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-4 focus-visible:outline-[#0C4DA2]"
              >
                Discover CIPRB
                <span className="flex h-11 w-11 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-white text-[#0C4DA2] transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:rotate-45">
                  <ArrowUpRight size={19} strokeWidth={1.8} />
                </span>
              </Link>

              <Link
                href="#research"
                className="group inline-flex min-h-12 items-center gap-2 text-[13px] font-semibold text-[#183C65] transition-colors hover:text-[#0C4DA2] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-4 focus-visible:outline-[#0C4DA2]"
              >
                Our Research
                <ArrowUpRight
                  size={17}
                  className="transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:translate-x-1 group-hover:-translate-y-1"
                />
              </Link>
            </div>

            {/* Compact desktop slide identity */}
            <div
              data-hero-reveal
              className="mt-12 hidden items-center gap-4 xl:flex"
            >
              <span className="text-[12px] font-bold tabular-nums text-[#0C4DA2]">
                {String(activeIndex + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
              </span>
              <div className="h-px w-12 bg-[#A8BBD1]" />
              <span className="text-[11px] font-medium tracking-[0.14em] text-[#8C9CAF] uppercase">
                Featured stories
              </span>
            </div>
          </div>

          {/* Right: immersive image composition */}
          <div className="relative">
            <div className="relative h-[390px] overflow-hidden rounded-[24px] bg-gradient-to-br from-[#D6E6F5] via-[#A7C4E4] to-[#4279B6] shadow-[0_30px_80px_-40px_rgba(15,49,94,0.4)] sm:h-[490px] sm:rounded-[32px] lg:h-[560px] xl:h-[630px]">
              {slides.map((slide, index) => (
                <div
                  key={slide.image}
                  aria-hidden="true"
                  className={`absolute inset-0 bg-cover bg-center transition-[opacity,transform] duration-[1100ms] ease-out motion-reduce:transition-none ${
                    index === activeIndex
                      ? "scale-100 opacity-100"
                      : "pointer-events-none scale-[1.055] opacity-0"
                  }`}
                  style={{
                    backgroundImage: `
                      linear-gradient(
                        180deg,
                        rgba(9, 35, 72, 0.02) 20%,
                        rgba(9, 35, 72, 0.08) 50%,
                        rgba(5, 30, 66, 0.7) 100%
                      ),
                      url("${slide.image}")
                    `,
                    backgroundPosition: slide.position ?? "center",
                  }}
                />
              ))}

              {/* Image visual frame */}
              <div className="pointer-events-none absolute inset-4 rounded-[15px] border border-white/25 sm:inset-6 sm:rounded-[23px]" />

              {/* Top right floating identifier */}
              <div className="absolute top-9 right-9 hidden items-center gap-2 rounded-full border border-white/30 bg-white/15 px-4 py-2.5 text-white backdrop-blur-xl sm:flex">
                <span className="h-1.5 w-1.5 rounded-full bg-white" />
                <span className="text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[0.14em] uppercase">
                  CIPRB / Bangladesh
                </span>
              </div>

              {/* Bottom image label */}
              <div className="absolute right-7 bottom-8 left-7 flex items-end justify-between gap-6 text-white sm:right-11 sm:bottom-11 sm:left-11">
                <div>
                  <p className="mb-2 text-[10px] font-bold tracking-[0.22em] text-white/75 uppercase">
                    Featured Programme
                  </p>
                  <p className="max-w-[380px] text-[clamp(1.3rem,2.5vw,2.2rem)] leading-[1.15] font-semibold tracking-[-0.045em]">
                    {activeSlide.title}
                  </p>
                </div>

                <span className="shrink-0 text-[12px] font-medium tabular-nums text-white/85">
                  {String(activeIndex + 1).padStart(2, "0")} /{" "}
                  {String(slides.length).padStart(2, "0")}
                </span>
              </div>
            </div>

            {/* Decorative floating circle */}
            <div
              aria-hidden="true"
              className="absolute -right-4 -bottom-5 hidden h-28 w-28 rounded-full border border-[#0C4DA2]/20 sm:block xl:-right-10 xl:-bottom-10 xl:h-40 xl:w-40"
            >
              <div className="absolute inset-4 rounded-full border border-[#0C4DA2]/15" />
              <div className="absolute inset-8 rounded-full border border-[#0C4DA2]/10" />
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>

        {/* Navigation / progress footer */}
        <div className="relative mt-14 flex flex-col gap-6 border-t border-[#D6E0EB] py-7 sm:mt-16 lg:mt-20 lg:flex-row lg:items-center lg:justify-between lg:gap-10">
          <div className="flex items-center gap-5">
            <span className="min-w-[60px] text-[13px] font-semibold tabular-nums text-[#153E68]">
              {String(activeIndex + 1).padStart(2, "0")}
              <span className="mx-2 text-[#9BAFC3]">/</span>
              {String(slides.length).padStart(2, "0")}
            </span>

            <div
              role="group"
              aria-label="Choose featured story"
              className="flex flex-1 items-center gap-2 sm:w-[230px] sm:flex-none"
            >
              {slides.map((slide, index) => (
                <button
                  key={slide.title}
                  type="button"
                  aria-label={`Show ${slide.title}`}
                  aria-pressed={activeIndex === index}
                  onClick={() => goTo(index)}
                  className="group flex h-8 flex-1 items-center"
                >
                  <span
                    className={`block h-[3px] w-full rounded-full transition-colors duration-300 ${
                      activeIndex === index
                        ? "bg-[#0C4DA2]"
                        : "bg-[#D4DEEA] group-hover:bg-[#9EB7D3]"
                    }`}
                  />
                </button>
              ))}
            </div>
          </div>

          <div className="flex items-center justify-between gap-5 lg:justify-end lg:gap-10">
            <Link
              href="#about"
              className="group flex items-center gap-3 text-[11px] font-bold tracking-[0.14em] text-[#73869B] uppercase transition-colors hover:text-[#0C4DA2]"
            >
              Scroll to explore
              <ArrowDown
                size={15}
                className="transition-transform duration-300 group-hover:translate-y-1"
              />
            </Link>

            <div className="flex items-center gap-2">
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => goTo(activeIndex - 1)}
                aria-label="Previous featured story"
                className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full border border-[#D6E0EB] text-[#0C4DA2] transition-all duration-300 hover:border-[#0C4DA2] hover:bg-[#E8F0FA] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-[#0C4DA2]"
              >
                <ArrowLeft size={19} strokeWidth={1.8} />
              </button>
              <button
                type="button"
                onClick={() => goTo(activeIndex + 1)}
                aria-label="Next featured story"
                className="flex h-12 w-12 items-center justify-center rounded-full bg-[#0C4DA2] text-white transition-all duration-300 hover:scale-105 hover:bg-[#083E84] focus-visible:outline-2 focus-visible:outline-offset-2 focus-visible:outline-[#0C4DA2]"
              >
                <ArrowRight size={19} strokeWidth={1.8} />
              </button>
            </div>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </section>
  );
}
